title: Yum-Yum Sauce
description: A creamy, tangy Japanese-inspired dipping sauce of mayonnaise, yogurt, sweet chilli, soy and lime.
steps: Mix all the ingredients together thoroughly in a small bowl.
Taste and adjust the balance of sweet, sour and salty to your preference.
Serve alongside the Crunchy Japanese-Style Rice Salad (p.187), or as a dipping sauce for grilled meats, vegetables or sushi rolls.
notes: Also great as a dipping sauce for spring rolls, or drizzled over grilled salmon or chicken. The sauce keeps in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
